title: v0.99.91 — Provider Contract & Test Hardening (Path B)
description: Frozen Path B from v0.99.87 W4. Path A rejected: fewer than two semantically identical primitives have repeated co-change; C9 alone is G1-blocked. Finding MA-09. Broad gates after W2-B and W4-B.

waves.title: v0.99.91 W0 — Provider Contract Golden Matrix
waves.body:
## Goal
Compare equivalent text/reasoning/usage/tools/SSE/timeout/partial/error scenarios across Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible, and Azure with explicit capability support.

## Gate
Provider tests + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Normalized chunk/error/telemetry matrix complete without artificial equality.

waves.title: v0.99.91 W1-B — Adapter Contract Completion
waves.body:
## Goal
Complete provider-specific contract cases and typed unsupported capabilities. No shared production abstraction.

## Gate
Provider contracts + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Every provider has explicit expectations for every W0 scenario.

waves.title: v0.99.91 W2-B — Differential Stream/Error Fixtures
waves.body:
## Goal
Version redacted provider-specific byte/JSON fixtures for framing, tools, usage, malformed input, and timeout phases.

## Gate
Broad + Security + review.

## Acceptance
Fixture matrix is complete, deterministic, redacted, and versioned.

waves.title: v0.99.91 W3-B — Provider Change-Locality Guards
waves.body:
## Goal
Enforce provider parser ownership and transport neutrality with positive/negative probes.

## Gate
Arch + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Provider logic cannot leak into shared modules and shared modules cannot absorb protocol details.

waves.title: v0.99.91 W4-B — Provider hardening reassessment and release
waves.body:
## Goal
Reassess contract coverage, defect localization, and change amplification; publish v0.99.91.

## Gate
Broad + Arch + Security + Provider Smoke + Release + independent review.

## Acceptance
Complete contracts, no capability regression, no unsupported abstraction, terminal MA-09 decision.
